fullText.simplified:
十一、姐姐的发现

    许仙和姐姐、姐夫住在一起。他每天高兴的样子让姐姐和姐夫觉得很奇怪。
    “弟弟最近怎么了？每天出门都这么高兴！”姐夫问。
    “我觉得他有心上人了。”姐姐说。
    “真的吗？那太好了！是哪家姑娘？”
    “不知道。我们明天跟在他后面，一定能看到那姑娘。”
    “好，我们一起去。”
    第二天早上，许仙刚出门，姐姐和姐夫就跟在他后面也出了门。他们跟着他来到西湖边，看到他进了一个白色的房子。姐姐和姐夫远远地站在外面，过了一会儿看到弟弟和一个穿白色衣服的姑娘出来了。白衣姑娘很漂亮，弟弟站在她身边，笑得很开心。弟弟和白衣姑娘去了街上的家具店，他们一起看家具。弟弟很关心白衣姑娘，把她照顾得很好。看完家具，弟弟和白衣姑娘一起去了饭店，他们坐在楼上吃饭。姐姐和姐夫在楼下看了一会儿，然后笑着离开了。
    “弟弟很喜欢那个姑娘！”姐夫说。
    “对！那个姑娘真漂亮！”姐姐说，“看上去也是好人家的姑娘。”
    “但她好像很有钱，我们家没有钱，她会不会不喜欢弟弟？”姐夫问。
    “这……我觉得应该不会。”
    “弟弟第一次这么喜欢一个姑娘，我们要帮帮他。”姐夫拿出一个小箱子，说：“我们家全部的钱都在这儿了，明天我们去见见那个姑娘吧。”
    姐姐明白姐夫的意思，她的眼睛红了，轻轻地点了点头。
    第二天，许仙要去药店工作。等他出了门，姐姐和姐夫拿着小箱子来到了西湖边的白房子前面。
    他们敲了敲门，开门的是小青。
    “你们是谁？是不是敲错门了？”小青问。
    “我们是许仙的姐姐和姐夫。我们想见一位穿白衣的姑娘，请问她在家吗？”姐姐说。
    “啊！是许公子的家人！我姐姐在家！”小青马上请他们进来。
    姐姐和姐夫进了门。白素贞有点儿吃惊，姐姐一见到她，就笑着说：“对不起，我们来得不礼貌。”
    白素贞马上说：“不会不会，我很高兴见到你们。”
    “姑娘，你叫什么名字？”
    “我姓白，叫白素贞。”
    “白姑娘，你好！我是许仙的姐姐，我叫许教容，这是我丈夫，他叫李公复。我们是为了弟弟许仙的事来见你的。”
    “许公子怎么没来？他出什么事了吗？”
    “没有没有，他没有事。我们是自己来的，他不知道。”
    “我明白了。你们见我，是有什么事吗？”

十一、姐姐的發現

    許仙和姐姐、姐夫住在一起。他每天高興的樣子讓姐姐和姐夫覺得很奇怪。
    “弟弟最近怎麼了？每天出門都這麼高興！”姐夫問。
    “我覺得他有心上人了。”姐姐說。
    “真的嗎？那太好了！是哪家姑娘？”
    “不知道。我們明天跟在他後面，一定能看到那姑娘。”
    “好，我們一起去。”
    第二天早上，許仙剛出門，姐姐和姐夫就跟在他後面也出了門。他們跟著他來到西湖邊，看到他進了一個白色的房子。姐姐和姐夫遠遠地站在外面，過了一會兒看到弟弟和一個穿白色衣服的姑娘出來了。白衣姑娘很漂亮，弟弟站在她身邊，笑得很開心。弟弟和白衣姑娘去了街上的家具店，他們一起看家具。弟弟很關心白衣姑娘，把她照顧得很好。看完家具，弟弟和白衣姑娘一起去了飯店，他們坐在樓上吃飯。姐姐和姐夫在樓下看了一會兒，然後笑著離開了。
    “弟弟很喜歡那個姑娘！”姐夫說。
    “對！那個姑娘真漂亮！”姐姐說，“看上去也是好人家的姑娘。”
    “但她好像很有錢，我們家沒有錢，她會不會不喜歡弟弟？”姐夫問。
    “這……我覺得應該不會。”
    “弟弟第一次這麼喜歡一個姑娘，我們要幫幫他。”姐夫拿出一個小箱子，說：“我們家全部的錢都在這兒了，明天我們去見見那個姑娘吧。”
    姐姐明白姐夫的意思，她的眼睛紅了，輕輕地點了點頭。
    第二天，許仙要去藥店工作。等他出了門，姐姐和姐夫拿著小箱子來到了西湖邊的白房子前面。
    他們敲了敲門，開門的是小青。
    “你們是誰？是不是敲錯門了？”小青問。
    “我們是許仙的姐姐和姐夫。我們想見一位穿白衣的姑娘，請問她在家嗎？”姐姐說。
    “啊！是許公子的家人！我姐姐在家！”小青馬上請他們進來。
    姐姐和姐夫進了門。白素貞有點兒吃驚，姐姐一見到她，就笑著說：“對不起，我們來得不禮貌。”
    白素貞馬上說：“不會不會，我很高興見到你們。”
    “姑娘，你叫什麼名字？”
    “我姓白，叫白素貞。”
    “白姑娘，你好！我是許仙的姐姐，我叫許教容，這是我丈夫，他叫李公復。我們是為了弟弟許仙的事來見你的。”
    “許公子怎麼沒來？他出什麼事了嗎？”
    “沒有沒有，他沒有事。我們是自己來的，他不知道。”
    “我明白了。你們見我，是有什麼事嗎？”

sentences.pinyin: bái gū niang nǐ hǎo wǒ shì xǔ xiān de jiě jie wǒ jiào xǔ jiào róng zhè shì wǒ zhàng fu tā jiào lǐ gōng fù
sentences.english: “Hello, Miss Bai! I am Xu Xian’s older sister. My name is Xu Jiaorong. This is my husband. His name is Li Gongfu.

sentences.simplified: 我们是为了弟弟许仙的事来见你的。”
sentences.traditional: 我們是為了弟弟許仙的事來見你的。”
sentences.pinyin: wǒ men shì wèi le dì di xǔ xiān de shì lái jiàn nǐ de
sentences.english: We came to see you about my younger brother Xu Xian.”

sentences.simplified: “许公子怎么没来？他出什么事了吗？”
sentences.traditional: “許公子怎麼沒來？他出什麼事了嗎？”
sentences.pinyin: xǔ gōng zǐ zěn me méi lái tā chū shén me shì le ma
sentences.english: “Why didn’t Young Master Xu come? Did something happen to him?”

sentences.simplified: “没有没有，他没有事。我们是自己来的，他不知道。”
sentences.traditional: “沒有沒有，他沒有事。我們是自己來的，他不知道。”
sentences.pinyin: méi yǒu méi yǒu tā méi yǒu shì wǒ men shì zì jǐ lái de tā bù zhī dào
sentences.english: “No, no, he’s fine. We came on our own. He doesn’t know.”

sentences.simplified: “我明白了。你们见我，是有什么事吗？”
sentences.traditional: “我明白了。你們見我，是有什麼事嗎？”
sentences.pinyin: wǒ míng bai le nǐ men jiàn wǒ shì yǒu shén me shì ma
sentences.english: “I see. Did you come to see me about something?”

sentence_translations: 11. Older Sister’s Discovery
Xu Xian lived with his older sister and brother-in-law.
Xu Xian’s older sister and brother-in-law found his happy demeanor every day to be a bit strange.
“What’s been going on with your younger brother lately? He’s so happy every time he leaves the house!” the brother-in-law asked.
“I think he has someone special in his heart,” the older sister said.
“Really? That’s great! Which family is the girl from?”
“I don’t know. If we follow him tomorrow, we will definitely be able to see that girl.”
“Okay, let’s go together.”
The next morning, just as Xu Xian left the house, his older sister and brother-in-law followed him out.
They followed him to the side of the West Lake and saw him enter a white house.
The older sister and brother-in-law stood outside at a distance.
After a while, they saw the younger brother come out with a girl in white.
The girl in white was very beautiful, and the younger brother stood beside her, smiling happily.
The younger brother and the girl in white went to a furniture store in town. They looked at furniture together.
The younger brother was very caring towards the girl in white and looked after her well.
After looking at furniture, the younger brother and the girl in white went to a restaurant together, where they sat upstairs and ate.
The older sister and brother-in-law watched for a while downstairs and then left, smiling.
“Your younger brother really likes that girl!” the brother-in-law said.
“Right! That girl is so beautiful!” the older sister said, “She also looks like she’s a girl from a good family.”
“But she seems to be very wealthy.  Our family doesn’t have a lot of money.
Will she not like your younger brother?” the brother-in-law asked.
“This … I don’t think it will be the case.”
“This is the first time your younger brother has liked a girl so much. We need to help him.”
The brother-in-law took out a small box and said, “All our family’s money is in here. Let’s go see that girl tomorrow.”
The older sister understood what the brother-in-law meant. Her eyes turned red, and she gently nodded.
The next day, Xu Xian had to go work at the pharmacy.
After he left, his older sister and brother-in-law arrived in front of the white house by the West Lake, carrying a small box.
They knocked on the door. The door was opened by Xiaoqing.
“Who are you? Did you knock on the wrong door?” Xiaoqing asked.
“We are Xu Xian’s older sister and brother-in-law. We want to see a girl in white. Is she at home?” the older sister asked.
“Ah! It’s Young Master Xu’s family! My older sister is home!” Xiaoqing immediately invited them in.
The older sister and brother-in-law came inside.
Bai Suzhen was a little surprised. As soon as the sister saw her, she smiled and said, “I’m sorry for our rudeness in coming unannounced.”
Bai Suzhen immediately said, “No, no, I’m very happy to see you.”
“Miss, what is your name?”
“My surname is Bai, and my name is Bai Suzhen.”
“Hello, Miss Bai! I am Xu Xian’s older sister. My name is Xu Jiaorong. This is my husband. His name is Li Gongfu.
We came to see you about my younger brother Xu Xian.”
“Why didn’t Young Master Xu come? Did something happen to him?”
“No, no, he’s fine. We came on our own. He doesn’t know.”
“I see. Did you come to see me about something?”
